name: FreeSplat
definition: A feed-forward framework that reconstructs geometrically consistent global 3D Gaussian Splatting from long sparse image sequences to support free-view synthesis across wide view ranges, eliminating redundancy in overlapping regions.
summary: FreeSplat is a feed-forward framework that reconstructs global 3D Gaussian Splatting from sparse images using pure CNNs to support wide-baseline free-view synthesis.
